q-usage-root-of-unity-undeclared.evidence: folio/quantum-observable-universe/lifting-and-descent/direct-limit-lusztig.md:1 — root-of-unity construction used without explicit regime declaration — We explicitly realise the algebra $\mathcal{A}_\infty$ ([direct limit algebra](#def:direct-limit-algebra)) as the Lusztig integral form of the quantised enveloping algebra $\mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2))$ \[lusztig1993]. At each level $n$, we obtain the fibre algebra $\mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2)$ by specialising the $\mathbb{Z}[q,q^{-1}]$-form $\mathcal{U}^{\mathbb{Z}}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2))$ ([substrate parameter](#def:substrate-parameter)) along $q \mapsto q_n \in k^{\times}$. The direct limit inherits the divided power basis $(E^{(m)}, F^{(m)}, K^{\pm 1})$ from the integral form. This ensures that the quaternionic jet embedding ([quaternionic spectral resolvents](#def:quaternionic-spectral-resolvents)) remains robust under the arithmetic :refterm[descent]{#descent} to $M_0$. The $q$-deformed scaling function $\exp_q(r) - 1$ (equation [eq:q-exp](#eq:q-exp)) regulates the transition between the divided power bases of the space-like and time-like resolvents.
